writing:fc:57.hint: ある場所で生まれ、その後そこで育つ、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:57.question: She was _____ in a small village.
writing:fc:57.fullSentence: She was born and brought up in a small village.
writing:fc:57.explanation: 生まれ育つという意味。

writing:fc:58.hint: 誰かの功績や人柄に強く心を動かされる、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:58.question: I was _____ her kindness.
writing:fc:58.fullSentence: I was deeply impressed by her kindness.
writing:fc:58.explanation: 深く感銘を受けるという意味。

writing:fc:59.hint: ある結果や物事について責任を負う立場にある、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:59.question: The manager _____ the team's performance.
writing:fc:59.fullSentence: The manager is responsible for the team's performance.
writing:fc:59.explanation: 責任があるという意味。

writing:fc:60.hint: 以前あった制度や習慣が正式に取りやめになる、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:60.question: The old rule was _____ last year.
writing:fc:60.fullSentence: The old rule was done away with last year.
writing:fc:60.explanation: 廃止されるという意味。

writing:fc:61.hint: ある事柄を特に疑問視せず当たり前だと考える、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:61.question: People often _____ that they can drink clean water.
writing:fc:61.fullSentence: People often take it for granted that they can drink clean water.
writing:fc:61.explanation: 当然のことと思うという意味。

writing:fc:62.hint: 急な予定変更などで実施日が先に延ばされる、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:62.question: The meeting _____ until next week.
writing:fc:62.fullSentence: The meeting was postponed until next week.
writing:fc:62.explanation: 延期されるという意味。

writing:fc:63.hint: 他人をおもしろがってからかう、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:63.question: The children _____ his accent.
writing:fc:63.fullSentence: The children made fun of his accent.

writing:fc:64.hint: 職場で決められた時間より長く働く、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:64.question: She had to _____ to finish the report.
writing:fc:64.fullSentence: She had to work overtime to finish the report.

writing:fc:65.hint: 自分の考えていることを話し言葉にして表す、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:65.question: 次の状況を最もよく表す英語表現を選びなさい。
choices: without saying a word or looking back
writing:fc:65.fullSentence: It is hard to express my feelings in words.
writing:fc:65.explanation: 言葉で表現するという意味。

writing:fc:66.hint: 「私は思う」よりも堅い書き言葉として好まれる表現は何か。
writing:fc:66.question: _____ that homework helps students learn better.
writing:fc:66.fullSentence: I believe that homework helps students learn better.
writing:fc:66.explanation: I thinkよりも論理的でformalな響きを持つ。

writing:fc:67.hint: 文頭でBut, And, Soの代わりに用いる堅い接続語は何か。
writing:fc:67.question: _____, the plan was later cancelled due to bad weather.
writing:fc:67.fullSentence: However, the plan was later cancelled due to bad weather.
writing:fc:67.explanation: エッセイではBut等の代わりにHowever/Furthermore/Thereforeを使う。

writing:fc:68.hint: ~をしながら、という同時進行の動作を表す構文は何か。
writing:fc:68.question: She listened to music _____ dinner.
writing:fc:68.fullSentence: She listened to music while cooking dinner.

writing:fc:69.hint: 時間を無駄に過ごさず、ある行為に使うという構文は何か。
writing:fc:69.question: 次の状況を最もよく表す英語表現を選びなさい。
writing:fc:69.answer: spends a lot of time playing
choices: spends a lot of time playing
writing:fc:69.fullSentence: He spends a lot of time playing video games.

writing:fc:70.hint: 理由を列挙する際に一番目を示す表現は何か。
writing:fc:70.question: _____, the cost of the project is too high.
writing:fc:70.fullSentence: Firstly, the cost of the project is too high.

writing:fc:71.hint: 一般的な事実や必要性を表す仮主語構文で、女性が一人で夜道を歩くのは危険だ、と述べる文はどう作るか。
writing:fc:71.question: 次の状況を最もよく表す英語表現を選びなさい。
writing:fc:71.answer: It is dangerous for women to walk
choices: It is dangerous for women to walk
The older you become, the more difficult
writing:fc:71.fullSentence: It is dangerous for women to walk alone at night.
writing:fc:71.explanation: It is 形容詞 for O to Vの構文。

writing:fc:72.hint: ある事が重要だと述べ、それが実現すべきだという意味を含む構文は何か。
writing:fc:72.question: 次の状況を最もよく表す英語表現を選びなさい。
writing:fc:72.answer: It is important that the report should
choices: It is important that the report should
writing:fc:72.fullSentence: It is important that the report should be submitted on time.
writing:fc:72.explanation: It is important that S should Vの構文。

writing:fc:73.hint: つい先頃ある行動を終えたばかりだと述べる時に使う時制の形は何か。
writing:fc:73.question: I _____ reading that novel.
writing:fc:73.fullSentence: I have recently finished reading that novel.
writing:fc:73.explanation: 「最近」を表す副詞は現在完了と結びつきやすい。

writing:fc:74.hint: 以前の状態から今は変化したことを表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:74.question: 次の状況を最もよく表す英語表現を選びなさい。
choices: If it were not for his help
spends a lot of time playing
writing:fc:74.fullSentence: He is not what he used to be after the accident.
writing:fc:74.explanation: 以前の状態と今の変化を対比する表現。

writing:fc:75.hint: 一方が変化するにつれて他方も比例して変化する、という構文は何か。
writing:fc:75.question: 次の状況を最もよく表す英語表現を選びなさい。
writing:fc:75.answer: The older you become, the more difficult
choices: The older you become, the more difficult
writing:fc:75.fullSentence: The older you become, the more difficult you find it to learn foreign languages.
writing:fc:75.explanation: the 比較級, the 比較級の構文。

writing:fc:76.hint: 数が少ないながらも存在することを肯定的に述べる表現は何か。
writing:fc:76.question: _____ in our class have visited Europe.
writing:fc:76.fullSentence: A few students in our class have visited Europe.
writing:fc:76.explanation: 肯定的な「少しはある」を表すa few。

writing:fc:77.hint: 量がほとんどないことを否定的に述べる表現は何か。
writing:fc:77.question: There is _____ of finding survivors.
writing:fc:77.fullSentence: There is little hope of finding survivors.
writing:fc:77.explanation: 否定的な「ほとんどない」を表すlittle。

writing:fc:78.hint: 何かの数が年々どんどん減っていることを強調する表現は何か。
writing:fc:78.question: _____ are reading newspapers these days.
writing:fc:78.fullSentence: Fewer and fewer people are reading newspapers these days.
writing:fc:78.explanation: 年々減っていることを強調する構文。

writing:fc:79.hint: ある集団の中で1人もその行動をしない、という否定を表す構文は何か。
writing:fc:79.question: _____ in our class has ever been abroad.
writing:fc:79.fullSentence: No one in our class has ever been abroad.

writing:fc:80.hint: 5人のうち1人といったように割合を表す構文は何か。
writing:fc:80.question: 次の状況を最もよく表す英語表現を選びなさい。
choices: not as difficult to learn Spanish as
writing:fc:80.fullSentence: One out of five students in our school walks to school.
writing:fc:80.explanation: 分数のような割合を表す構文。

writing:fc:81.hint: はっきりとした考えを持たずに何となく行動する、という様子を表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:81.question: 次の状況を最もよく表す英語表現を選びなさい。
writing:fc:81.answer: without any clear idea in mind
choices: If it were not for his help
without any clear idea in mind
writing:fc:81.fullSentence: He answered the question without any clear idea in mind.
writing:fc:81.explanation: 何も考えずに、という意味の表現。
